experience.raw_text:  Working as a Bio-statistician in Muljibhai Patel Urological Hospital (MPUH), Nadiad, Gujarat since 11 December 2019. As a Statistician, I am responsible for the following:  Writing Statistical Analysis Plan according to the objectives of study as provided by doctors for their research projects.  Preparing master file into analyzable form.  Analysis of hospital data with the help of different software like SPSS, R-Language and MEDCALC as per the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).  Making Graphics using software like SPSS, MS EXCEL, R-Language and MS POWERPOINT.  Reporting and interpreting the outcome of the analysis.  Writing and reviewing in statistical part of DNB projects, Company Grants, Govt. Projects  I was worked in Sardar Patel University as an Assistant Professor (Adhoc)
